(9) git status ~60 dirty files spot-checked (artists.controller.ts, briefings.controller.ts, contract-templates.controller.ts, releases.controller.ts, governance/naming.ts) are genuinely PT-PT->PT-BR spelling-only diffs (Actualizar->Atualizar) orthogonal to this mission's own already-committed changes.
